newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar closes stable in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar closes stable in slow trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed stable at 470.50/471.75 bolivars per dollar in a quiet market that was supplied by Central Bank dollars, traders said.
"The market was relatively stable and the Central Bank covered the whole demand," in particular one from a big corporation, one trader said.
Traders said demand was mainly motivated by the fact that Monday is a holiday with the observance of All Saints' Day.
